title: Software development team
description: Give a coding host a spec; its coordinator selects from sixteen professional roles, records responsibility coverage and organizes design, implementation, integration, verification and acceptance.

roles.title: Product and delivery coordinator

activation.when: Every project: own planning, selection and delivery.

responsibilities: Own intake, team selection, scoped tasks, integration and budgets.
outputs: Questions, team decisions, contracts, plan and delivery.

roles.title: Requirements review specialist

activation.when: Every project: establish clear, testable requirements.

responsibilities: Review ambiguity, boundaries, business rules and verifiability.
outputs: Sourced requirement IDs, scope decisions and acceptance scenarios.

roles.title: Product, UX and UI designer

activation.when: New or changed user journeys, screens or interactions.

responsibilities: Design journeys, interactions and accessibility; inspect conformance.
outputs: Flow/state specifications, design decisions and findings.

roles.title: Architecture and interface specialist

activation.when: Every project: assess interfaces, compatibility and quality risks; scale depth to scope.

responsibilities: Define architecture, interfaces, data ownership and compatibility.
outputs: Technical contracts, tradeoffs and implementation slices.

roles.title: Frontend and interaction specialist
responsibilities: Implement agreed interfaces, states and user interactions.
outputs: Scoped UI changes, interaction evidence and integration notes.

roles.title: Backend and data specialist

activation.when: Business logic, services, APIs or library implementation.

responsibilities: Implement business logic, APIs, persistence and failure handling.
outputs: Scoped code, behavioral tests and compatibility notes.

roles.title: Functional, integration and regression tester

activation.when: Every project: define and execute meaningful behavioral checks.

responsibilities: Map requirements to functional, integration and regression checks.
outputs: Traceable checks, actual results and reproducible defects.

roles.title: Security engineering and review specialist

activation.when: Changed trust boundaries, sensitive data, permissions, dependencies or security requirements.

responsibilities: Define security controls; independently review the candidate and fixes.
outputs: Scoped requirements, findings and verification results.

roles.title: Performance and load testing specialist

activation.when: Performance targets, scaling changes, heavy workloads or regression risks.

responsibilities: Plan bounded workloads/targets, measure results and diagnose regressions.
outputs: Reproducible benchmarks, raw measurements and threshold results.

roles.title: Independent implementation reviewer

activation.when: Every project: independent assessment of the integrated candidate.

responsibilities: Independently review the integrated implementation and compatibility.
outputs: Candidate-specific procedure, findings and review result.

roles.title: Requirements acceptance specialist

activation.when: Every project: independently match delivered behavior to the spec.

responsibilities: Plan coverage; independently assess delivered business/quality requirements.
outputs: Requirement/evidence matrix, gaps and acceptance recommendation.

roles.title: Integration engineer

activation.when: Multiple implementation workers, shared interfaces or cross-module changes; coordinator covers simple integration.

responsibilities: Coordinate interfaces, merge scoped changes and check integration.
outputs: Combined candidate, conflict decisions and integration evidence.

roles.title: Build and delivery engineer

activation.when: Build, packaging, CI/CD, environment or deployment changes.

responsibilities: Prepare reproducible builds, delivery and rollback procedures.
outputs: Build/configuration evidence, artifact and release procedure.

roles.title: Database and migration engineer

activation.when: Complex schemas, migrations, transactions, query/index tuning or data compatibility changes.

responsibilities: Design compatible data contracts, migrations and query behavior.
outputs: Data/migration code, compatibility and recovery evidence.

roles.title: Documentation and developer experience engineer

activation.when: Changed user/API behavior, installation, integration, operation or handover instructions.

responsibilities: Document delivered behavior and verify setup, examples and guidance.
outputs: User/API docs, verified examples and handover notes.

roles.title: Reliability and operations engineer

activation.when: Long-running services, availability targets, monitoring, recovery or operational changes.

responsibilities: Define health signals, recovery behavior and operational readiness.
outputs: Monitoring, runbooks, bounded recovery evidence and findings.

workflow.title: Read the spec and clarify material gaps
Review requirements and define acceptance coverage
Select roles and record responsibility coverage from the spec
Design the experience, architecture and quality targets
Prepare scoped tasks, test plans and quality checks
Implement scoped code, infrastructure and documentation
Integrate changes and identify the candidate
Verify integrated behavior, design and data compatibility
Verify scoped security requirements and fixes
Measure agreed workloads and performance targets
Verify build, documentation and operational readiness
Accept the delivered requirements against all required evidence
Save the accepted integrated result and handoff
